---
title: "Tree-Based Methods for Predicting Online Shopping Purchases"
author: "Bazgan"
date: "2026-05-05"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
packages <- c(
  "tidyverse", "caret", "glmnet", "randomForest",
  "gbm", "pROC", "knitr"
)

for (p in packages) {
  if (!require(p, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(p, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

set.seed(123)

url <- "https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/468/online+shoppers+purchasing+intention+dataset.zip"
download.file(url, "online_shoppers.zip", mode = "wb")
unzip("online_shoppers.zip")

data <- read.csv("online_shoppers_intention.csv")

str(data)
summary(data)
table(data$Revenue)
prop.table(table(data$Revenue))

data$Revenue <- as.factor(ifelse(data$Revenue == TRUE, "Purchase", "NoPurchase"))
data$Weekend <- as.factor(data$Weekend)
data$Month <- as.factor(data$Month)
data$VisitorType <- as.factor(data$VisitorType)
data$OperatingSystems <- as.factor(data$OperatingSystems)
data$Browser <- as.factor(data$Browser)
data$Region <- as.factor(data$Region)
data$TrafficType <- as.factor(data$TrafficType)

set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(data$Revenue, p = 0.70, list = FALSE)

train_data <- data[train_index, ]
test_data <- data[-train_index, ]

table(train_data$Revenue)
table(test_data$Revenue)

x_train <- model.matrix(Revenue ~ ., train_data)[, -1]
y_train <- train_data$Revenue

x_test <- model.matrix(Revenue ~ ., test_data)[, -1]
y_test <- test_data$Revenue

set.seed(123)
lasso_cv <- cv.glmnet(
  x_train,
  y_train,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 1,
  type.measure = "class"
)

best_lambda <- lasso_cv$lambda.min
best_lambda

lasso_pred_prob <- predict(lasso_cv, newx = x_test, s = best_lambda, type = "response")
lasso_pred <- ifelse(lasso_pred_prob > 0.5, "Purchase", "NoPurchase")
lasso_pred <- factor(lasso_pred, levels = levels(y_test))

lasso_cm <- confusionMatrix(lasso_pred, y_test, positive = "Purchase")
lasso_cm

lasso_auc <- auc(y_test, as.numeric(lasso_pred_prob))
lasso_auc

lasso_coef <- coef(lasso_cv, s = best_lambda)
lasso_selected <- lasso_coef[lasso_coef[, 1] != 0, , drop = FALSE]
lasso_selected

p <- ncol(train_data) - 1

set.seed(123)
bagging_model <- randomForest(
  Revenue ~ .,
  data = train_data,
  mtry = p,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

bagging_pred <- predict(bagging_model, test_data)
bagging_prob <- predict(bagging_model, test_data, type = "prob")[, "Purchase"]

bagging_cm <- confusionMatrix(bagging_pred, test_data$Revenue, positive = "Purchase")
bagging_cm

bagging_auc <- auc(test_data$Revenue, bagging_prob)
bagging_auc

varImpPlot(bagging_model, main = "Variable Importance Plot: Bagging")
mtry_values <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)

rf_results <- data.frame()

for (m in mtry_values) {
  set.seed(123)
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    Revenue ~ .,
    data = train_data,
    mtry = m,
    ntree = 500,
    importance = TRUE
  )
  
  rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
  rf_prob <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")[, "Purchase"]
  
  cm <- confusionMatrix(rf_pred, test_data$Revenue, positive = "Purchase")
  auc_value <- auc(test_data$Revenue, rf_prob)
  
  rf_results <- rbind(
    rf_results,
    data.frame(
      mtry = m,
      Accuracy = cm$overall["Accuracy"],
      Sensitivity = cm$byClass["Sensitivity"],
      Specificity = cm$byClass["Specificity"],
      AUC = as.numeric(auc_value)
    )
  )
}

kable(rf_results, caption = "Random Forest Tuning Results")
best_mtry <- rf_results$mtry[which.max(rf_results$AUC)]

set.seed(123)
best_rf_model <- randomForest(
  Revenue ~ .,
  data = train_data,
  mtry = best_mtry,
  ntree = 500,
  importance = TRUE
)

rf_pred <- predict(best_rf_model, test_data)
rf_prob <- predict(best_rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")[, "Purchase"]

rf_cm <- confusionMatrix(rf_pred, test_data$Revenue, positive = "Purchase")
rf_cm

rf_auc <- auc(test_data$Revenue, rf_prob)
rf_auc

varImpPlot(best_rf_model, main = "Variable Importance Plot: Random Forest")

boost_train <- train_data
boost_test <- test_data

boost_train$RevenueNum <- ifelse(boost_train$Revenue == "Purchase", 1, 0)
boost_test$RevenueNum <- ifelse(boost_test$Revenue == "Purchase", 1, 0)

boost_train$Revenue <- NULL
boost_test$Revenue <- NULL

boost_grid <- expand.grid(
  n.trees = c(500, 1000, 1500),
  interaction.depth = c(1, 2, 3),
  shrinkage = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1)
)

boost_results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(boost_grid)) {
  set.seed(123)
  
  boost_model <- gbm(
    RevenueNum ~ .,
    data = boost_train,
    distribution = "bernoulli",
    n.trees = boost_grid$n.trees[i],
    interaction.depth = boost_grid$interaction.depth[i],
    shrinkage = boost_grid$shrinkage[i],
    n.minobsinnode = 10,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  boost_prob <- predict(
    boost_model,
    newdata = boost_test,
    n.trees = boost_grid$n.trees[i],
    type = "response"
  )
  
  boost_pred <- ifelse(boost_prob > 0.5, "Purchase", "NoPurchase")
  boost_pred <- factor(boost_pred, levels = levels(test_data$Revenue))
  
  cm <- confusionMatrix(boost_pred, test_data$Revenue, positive = "Purchase")
  auc_value <- auc(test_data$Revenue, boost_prob)
  
  boost_results <- rbind(
    boost_results,
    data.frame(
      n.trees = boost_grid$n.trees[i],
      interaction.depth = boost_grid$interaction.depth[i],
      shrinkage = boost_grid$shrinkage[i],
      Accuracy = as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]),
      Sensitivity = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
      Specificity = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]),
      AUC = as.numeric(auc_value)
    )
  )
}

kable(boost_results, caption = "Boosting Tuning Results")
best_boost <- boost_results[which.max(boost_results$AUC), ]

set.seed(123)

best_boost_model <- gbm(
  RevenueNum ~ .,
  data = boost_train,
  distribution = "bernoulli",
  n.trees = best_boost$n.trees,
  interaction.depth = best_boost$interaction.depth,
  shrinkage = best_boost$shrinkage,
  n.minobsinnode = 10,
  verbose = FALSE
)

boost_prob <- predict(
  best_boost_model,
  newdata = boost_test,
  n.trees = best_boost$n.trees,
  type = "response"
)

boost_pred <- ifelse(boost_prob > 0.5, "Purchase", "NoPurchase")
boost_pred <- factor(boost_pred, levels = levels(test_data$Revenue))

boost_cm <- confusionMatrix(boost_pred, test_data$Revenue, positive = "Purchase")
boost_cm

boost_auc <- auc(test_data$Revenue, boost_prob)
boost_auc

summary(best_boost_model, main = "Variable Importance Plot: Boosting")
model_comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Lasso", "Bagging", "Random Forest", "Boosting"),
  Accuracy = c(
    lasso_cm$overall["Accuracy"],
    bagging_cm$overall["Accuracy"],
    rf_cm$overall["Accuracy"],
    boost_cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Sensitivity = c(
    lasso_cm$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    bagging_cm$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    rf_cm$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    boost_cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    lasso_cm$byClass["Specificity"],
    bagging_cm$byClass["Specificity"],
    rf_cm$byClass["Specificity"],
    boost_cm$byClass["Specificity"]
  ),
  AUC = c(
    as.numeric(lasso_auc),
    as.numeric(bagging_auc),
    as.numeric(rf_auc),
    as.numeric(boost_auc)
  )
)

kable(model_comparison, caption = "Final Model Comparison on Test Set")
```
